'''Triton''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Triton system/Legends|Triton system]] of the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was orbited by a single [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].
